scope: One original Quake Ogre MDL6/native skin intake; not all model/skin/expansion coverage or artwork acceptance
identityPolicy: Intake identity is SHA256 of canonical compact sorted JSON(modelSHA256,skin,frame,dimensions,indexedSHA256,paletteSHA256,rgbaSHA256), explicitly local proof identity; runtime matches full MDL SHA256.
mountProfile: Current source-web Quake base only: owner Quake pak0 mounted first, bundled shareware pak0 last and wins; COM_FindFile packs precede preloaded virtual loose. Actual filesystem loose candidates also checked absent. Desktop/other running profiles not exercised.

uv.formula: s=(s+.5+(width/2 if !facesfront && onseam else0))/width, t=(t+.5)/height; top-row-first texture flipY=false
uv.rasterCaveat: Pillow polygon footprint follows existing uv_footprint formula; native connected components are a raster inspection aid, not artist/anatomical island identities. Mesh-edge correspondences define continuity, not image perimeter repeats.

writes: Only owned Ogre intake proof folder; raw native extraction and diagnostic images, no runtime/official/authoring asset writes
